I fixed this in `src/rules.ts`. The inline `br` rule now also consumes any spaces or tabs at the start of the next line. I haven't run it or the test suite, since there's no `node_modules`. The rule is now `/^( {2,}|\\)\n(?!\s*$)[ \t]*/`. The "not at end of text" check still comes before the whitespace, so a trailing break at the end of a paragraph behaves as before. By my reading, `foo ⏎ bar` should now render as `

foo
bar

`. The backslash and tab cases go through the same rule. The `breaks: true` variant is built from the same rule, so it should pick up the fix too.
